_doc: Wardrobe dept — physical BlenderKit character/garment assets (distinct from catalog/talent.json, which is the on-air PERSONA). A talent entry references a wardrobe item by id via its `avatar`/`wardrobe` field. blend_format must be <= BLENDER-v402 to open in rtx0's Blender 4.2. `hair_ok` = hair stays out of the face on-camera. Managed by newscast/wardrobe.py.

businessman_anchor.name: Businessman
businessman_anchor.notes: Best male foundation: natural hair (no glossy issue), v402-compatible. Face is swapped (anchorM.png).

business_female.name: Business Female Character Formal Suit
business_female.notes: First female pull. Hair drapes the face + renders glossy (fix via HAAR graft). hd_blend = clean DEEP NAVY suit via `retexture --method recolor` (LAB luminance-preserving chroma transfer; sd.cpp/Klein picks the color from an edited render). Artifact-free. NOTE: --method klein (projection-bake) gives digital-camo on this jacket's fragmented UV islands -- use recolor for color changes, klein only for spatial patterns on clean UVs. Blouse tints light-blue with the suit (neutral texel); mask by UV quadrant if it must stay white.

formal_woman.name: Formal woman
formal_woman.hair: wavy bob card-mesh — renders as rubbery grey helmet
formal_woman.outfit: gold bare-shoulder goddess gown (wrong for news)
formal_woman.notes: REJECTED (Qwen 4/10, me: fail). MakeHuman elvs_ char: card-mesh hair shades like molded rubber + evening-gown outfit. LESSON: avoid MakeHuman (elvs_) female chars — bad hair + costume outfits. Face-swap/skin were fine.

talking_arab_woman.name: Talking Arab Woman
talking_arab_woman.outfit: black hijab head-covering + shawl (satiny — soften roughness)
talking_arab_woman.notes: WINNER (Qwen 9/10, me: best female yet). Proper ARKit-52 face rig (native eyeBlink/browInnerUp/jawOpen/visemes — no fake aliases) + clean Head/Neck bones. Hijab removes the hair-render gamble entirely. Face-swap (reporter_face) makes her photoreal + blends the muse seam.
